title: roucela erinus
intro: Roucela erinus, commonly known as the sweet alyssum, is a small, annual flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. The sweet alyssum has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its potential to help alleviate anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects. It is believed to have therapeutic actions such as sedative and anti-anxiety properties, making it a natural remedy for stress relief. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils.
